configurations.description: A comma-separated list of case-sensitive message header name glob patterns to exclude from span attributes. `?` matches one character and `*` matches zero or more characters. Excluded patterns take precedence over included patterns. An absent or empty selector captures no headers; an exclude-only selector captures every header not excluded, which may expose sensitive information.
